questions.question_text: Read the unseen passage segment context. According to the text, why did the ancient mariners fear sailing beyond the visible horizon?
options: A) They believed the ocean was filled with sweet water.
B) They feared falling off the edge of a flat Earth.
C) They lacked strong wooden boats.
D) They were afraid of friendly dolphins.
questions.answer: B) They feared falling off the edge of a flat Earth.

questions.question_text: Choose the word from the passage that means 'to travel completely around the world'.
questions.answer: C) Circumnavigate

questions.question_text: Based on the passage, the compass was a revolutionary invention because it allowed sailors to:
options: B) Find direction even on cloudy nights without stars.
C) Measure the depth of the deep sea.
D) Speak with different foreign cultures.
questions.answer: B) Find direction even on cloudy nights without stars.

questions.question_text: Explain how the invention of sturdy caravels (ships) changed global trade according to the passage. [30-40 words]
questions.answer: Sturdy caravels, with their deep hulls and triangular sails, allowed sailors to safely sail against strong winds across vast, dangerous oceans. This directly connected distant continents, rapidly expanding global trade routes and the exchange of exotic goods.

questions.question_text: Identify one major challenge that early explorers faced during long ocean voyages as described in the text. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Early explorers faced severe challenges like deadly diseases such as scurvy due to a lack of fresh food, violent storms, and the constant fear of getting hopelessly lost.

questions.question_text: What does the author suggest about the courage of these early sailors in the concluding paragraph? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The author suggests that despite knowing the massive risks, their intense curiosity and immense courage to explore the unknown helped map the modern world we live in today.

sections.section_name: Section B - Writing Skills & Applied Grammar

questions.question_text: Identify the option that correctly converts the given sentence into Indirect Speech: She said, 'I am reading a wonderful book today.'
options: A) She says that she is reading a wonderful book today.
B) She said that she was reading a wonderful book that day.
C) She said that she is reading a wonderful book today.
D) She says she was reading a wonderful book that day.
questions.answer: B) She said that she was reading a wonderful book that day.

questions.question_text: Fill in the blank with the appropriate preposition: The frightened cat hid ____ the large wooden bed during the thunderstorm.
questions.answer: C) under

questions.question_text: Identify the option that correctly converts the given sentence into the Active Voice: 'The beautiful song was sung by the choir.'
options: A) The choir is singing the beautiful song.
B) The choir sings the beautiful song.
C) The choir sang the beautiful song.
D) The beautiful song sings the choir.
questions.answer: C) The choir sang the beautiful song.

questions.question_text: Choose the correct coordinating conjunction to join these two sentences: He studied very hard for the test. He did not get a good grade.
questions.answer: C) but

questions.question_text: Identify the adverb of manner in the following sentence: 'The old man walked slowly across the crowded street.'
questions.answer: C) slowly

questions.question_text: Fill in the blank with the correct form of the verb to ensure Subject-Verb Agreement: Neither the principal nor the teachers ____ present at the meeting.
questions.answer: B) are

questions.question_text: Choose the correct punctuation for the given sentence: what a beautiful painting this is
options: A) What a beautiful painting this is.
B) What a beautiful painting this is?
C) What a beautiful painting this is!
D) what a beautiful painting this is!
questions.answer: C) What a beautiful painting this is!

questions.question_text: Select the correct antonym for the word 'Arrogant'.
questions.answer: B) Humble

questions.question_text: Write a short paragraph describing the joy and vibrant atmosphere of a local village fair (Mela). [50-60 words]
questions.answer: The local village fair is a burst of vibrant colors, joyous laughter, and sweet aromas. Crowded stalls sell shiny glass bangles, wooden toys, and delicious hot jalebis. Children scream with immense delight on the giant Ferris wheel, while traditional folk music fills the cool evening air, creating an unforgettable atmosphere of pure community celebration.

questions.question_text: Write a formal application to your school Principal requesting a three-day leave of absence to attend your elder sister's wedding out of town. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: To The Principal, St. Xavier's School. Subject: Application for three days' leave. Respected Sir, I am writing to inform you that my elder sister's wedding is scheduled for next week out of town. I kindly request you to grant me leave for three days, from 15th to 17th November. I will ensure all missed work is completed. Thank you. Yours obediently, Rahul Sharma, Class 6.

questions.question_text: Read the extract from the poem 'The Kites': 'Up in the air / See how they fly / Like colored birds / Against the sky.' What is the poet comparing the kites to in these lines? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The poet is using a simile to compare the vibrant, soaring kites to colorful birds flying freely against the vast backdrop of the open sky.

questions.question_text: Read the extract from 'Hamara Bharat Incredible India': 'From the snowy peaks to the southern seas...' What core idea about India does this geographical description highlight? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: This description highlights the immense geographical diversity and vast physical expanse of India, uniting the freezing northern mountains with the warm southern oceans.

questions.question_text: In the chapter 'Spices that Heal Us', which common spice is highlighted for its strong antiseptic properties and ability to heal wounds? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Turmeric (Haldi) is strongly highlighted for its excellent antiseptic and anti-inflammatory properties, making it a traditional remedy for healing deep cuts and wounds.

questions.question_text: Why was the National War Memorial constructed, and what does it symbolize for the citizens? [30-40 words]
questions.answer: The National War Memorial was constructed to deeply honor and remember the brave soldiers of the Indian Armed Forces who sacrificed their lives. It symbolizes supreme courage, selfless duty, and eternal gratitude of the nation.

questions.question_text: According to the chapter 'Yoga A Way of Life', how does practicing yoga regularly benefit a student both physically and mentally? [30-40 words]
questions.answer: Practicing yoga improves physical flexibility, builds core strength, and corrects bad posture. Mentally, deep breathing and meditation reduce exam stress, increase focus, and calm the anxious mind for better overall studies.

questions.question_text: In the story 'The Winner', how did the protagonist's attitude change from the beginning of the race to the very end? [30-40 words]
questions.answer: Initially, the protagonist was arrogant and focused solely on winning at any cost. However, by the end, he realized that true sportsmanship and helping a fallen competitor was far more valuable than just crossing the finish line first.

questions.question_text: Analyze the inspiring journey of Ila Sachani in 'Embroidering Dreams with Her Feet'. How does her story prove that physical limitations cannot stop true passion and creativity? [50-60 words]
questions.answer: Ila Sachani was born with hands that could not function properly. Despite this severe physical challenge, she did not give up. She trained her feet to hold a needle and master the intricate Kathiawadi embroidery. Her incredible journey proves that with immense willpower, dedication, and true passion, physical disabilities cannot restrict a person from creating beautiful art and achieving their dreams.

questions.question_text: Based on the story 'Change of Heart', discuss how an act of unexpected kindness can transform a person's bitter character. Use specific examples from the text. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: The story beautifully shows that a bitter character, hardened by past troubles, can melt when shown genuine compassion. When the young boy offered to help the grumpy old man without expecting a reward, it sparked a deep realization in the man. This selfless act of unexpected kindness dissolved his anger, transforming him into a warm, helpful neighbor, proving that love cures bitterness.
